question: Which organization publishes the World Competitiveness Ranking?
solution:
The correct answer is __**IMD**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **World Competitiveness Ranking** is published by the **International Institute for Management Development (IMD)**, based in Lausanne, Switzerland.
 
• The IMD World Competitiveness Center has been publishing this ranking annually since **1989**.
 
• The ranking evaluates the competitiveness of countries based on **economic performance, government efficiency, business efficiency, and infrastructure**.
 
• The IMD World Competitiveness Ranking is considered one of the most respected and widely referenced benchmarks for global competitiveness.
 
• The rankings are derived from a combination of **hard data and survey responses** from business executives worldwide.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **2025 IMD World Competitiveness Ranking**:

 
 
• **India Rank**: **41** out of 69 Economies.
 
• **Switzerland ranked first**.
 
• Followed by Singapore and Hong Kong.
 
 
 
• **IMD (International Institute for Management Development):**
 
 
• Founded in **1990**, IMD is a private business school located in Lausanne, Switzerland.
 
• It specializes in developing global business leaders through its MBA and executive education programs.
 
• The IMD World Competitiveness Ranking is one of its flagship publications and is widely used by policymakers, businesses, and researchers globally.
 
 
 
• **Criteria for World Competitiveness Ranking:**
 
 
• The ranking is based on four main factors: **Economic Performance**, **Government Efficiency**, **Business Efficiency**, and **Infrastructure**.
 
• Each of these factors is further divided into sub-factors that include metrics like **GDP growth, productivity, employment, business regulations, and technology adoption**.
 
• The data is collected from both statistical sources and responses to surveys conducted among business executives worldwide.
 
 
 
• **Other Global Rankings:**
 
 
• The **World Economic Forum** publishes the **Global Competitiveness Report**, which is different from the IMD World Competitiveness Ranking.
 
• The **World Bank** releases reports such as the **Ease of Doing Business Index**, which evaluates business regulations across countries.
 
• The **International Monetary Fund (IMF)** focuses on financial stability and publishes reports like the **World Economic Outlook**.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• **IMD World Competitiveness Yearbook:**

 
 
• IMD publishes the **World Competitiveness Yearbook** annually, which contains detailed insights into the competitiveness rankings.
 
• The yearbook includes profiles of each country, highlighting key indicators and trends.
 
 
 
• **Impact of Competitiveness Rankings:**
 
 
• Countries with higher rankings tend to attract more foreign investments due to their favorable business environments.
 
• Lower-ranked countries often focus on reforms to improve their rankings, leading to better economic policies and infrastructure development.
 
 
 
• **Key Difference:**
 
 
• While both IMD and the World Economic Forum publish competitiveness rankings, IMD’s approach is more focused on **quantitative data and executive opinions**.
 
• The World Economic Forum's Global Competitiveness Report, on the other hand, places greater emphasis on **qualitative metrics** and long-term development goals.
